decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer is core hardware for a growing firm meeting its aspirations, so no problemistic search pushes a drop and slack lets it keep maturing.
The coder for non-absorbent surfaces extends the firm's core ink and coding expertise to more customer applications, and with no performance shortfall the satisficing choice is to keep it.

The CodeScan app is a low-cost successor to PharmaScan that supports the firm's traceability direction, though small apps like this tend to be renamed or replaced, so the drop risk is somewhat higher.
Inline code verification is central to the serialization and traceability strategy, so it fits the firm's aspirations and calls for no search for other uses of its resources.
The layout design software enables common operation across the firm's systems and was featured on the home page, so it is kept, with some risk that it is folded into a broader software suite.
